description: This Perl script 'checksrc.pl' is a source code file used for static code analysis or linting. It checks C/C++ source files for various style and warning rules, parsing input files and reporting issues, warnings, and errors based on coding standards.

methods.name: readskiplist
methods.description: Reads the skip list from 'checksrc.skip' file, populating the %skiplist hash.

methods.name: readlocalfile
methods.description: Reads local warning configurations from '.checksrc' to enable or disable specific warnings.

methods.name: checkwarn
methods.description: Reports a warning or error based on the analysis, incrementing counters and printing messages.

methods.name: accept_violations
methods.description: Accepts specified warning violations, marking them to be ignored for the current file.

methods.name: checksrc_clear
methods.description: Clears ignore-related hashes and arrays used during file analysis.

methods.name: checksrc_endoffile
methods.description: Checks for unused warning ignores at the end of file processing.

methods.name: scanfile
methods.description: Main function that scans a source file line by line, looking for coding standard violations and warnings.

methods.name: nostrings
methods.description: Removes quoted strings from a line to facilitate pattern matching.
